column1: # The models Splash suggests, best first: the desktop app offers them and shell
# ID splash serve --model takes, the model's name, the smallest Mac memory in
# GB the variant is meant for, its download in whole GB (the model, its vision
# projector if it has one, and its DFlash2 draft), and a few words for choosing
# among the models, the same for every variant of a name. The app offers, per
# name, the variant with the most MEMORY that the Mac has; README.md's Models
# table must list only these IDs.
